gold: undifferentiated embryonal sarcoma of the liver

selector.rationale: Mucinous cystadenocarcinoma best explains the imaging findings of a multilocular cystic tumor with septa and solid components, and the laboratory results, including elevated DUPAN-2 and CA125 levels, without contradiction.

rejected.label: Intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm
rejected.why: Not supported by the presence of a large, heterogeneous, multilocular cystic tumor with solid components in the liver

rejected.label: liver sarcoma
rejected.why: Less specific than Hepatic sarcoma and does not fully explain the mucinous components suggested by imaging and lab findings
